rules.title: Game Rules
rules.intro: The system randomly selects an Arknights operator. Your task is to guess who it is!
rules.step1: Type an operator name in the search box
rules.step2: Select an operator from the dropdown as your guess
rules.step3: Check the comparison table to see how each attribute matches
rules.step4: Use the color hints to adjust your next guess
rules.step5: Find the correct answer within 10 guesses!
rules.correctDesc: This attribute is exactly the same as the target operator
rules.closeDesc: This attribute is somewhat related (same class branch, adjacent rarity, same faction group)
rules.wrongDesc: This attribute is completely different from the target operator
rules.closeRuleRarity: Rarity: difference of 1 star (e.g. target is 5★, guessed 4★ or 6★)
rules.closeRuleSubclass: Subclass: same main class but different subclass
rules.closeRuleFaction: Faction: same faction group (e.g. Rhodes Island affiliates)
rules.tip: Tip: You can search operators using either Chinese or English names!
